description: Cross-product acceptance wall for the family retrieval-operations contract (plan 51 Q0). Every vendored copy of contracts/retrieval_ops.py must satisfy these rows: the read/action DTO vocabulary, the VECTOR_* job + run-result contract, the vector.* audit vocabulary, the two bounded rollup schemas, the single-active-run/idempotency seams, the alert defaults and the no-raw-text rule. Same law, one table, never per-repo edits.

quality.rule: golden-query text is admin-authored fixture input; QualityDTO/QualityCompareDTO expose ids, scores and miss lists only

alerts.condition: coverage below the gate with no active building run
a VECTOR_* run reaches terminal failed
a non-terminal run makes no progress past the stall window
alerts.recovery: progress resumes or the run is cancelled/reaped

alerts.condition: the pre-cutover golden-query compare misses the floor
query p95 exceeds the budget for the SLO window
the lexical-fallback share exceeds the threshold
the embeddings task has no provider/model assignment
the pgvector extension/index is absent on web
the token-denominated embed budget is exhausted
a retired space is past the drop grace period

metadata.note: caller-supplied embedding tags: space_id, kind, view, chunk_index — passed through the gateway call like run_id/run_stage, never written by the gateway itself; no prompt/document text

schemaVersion.note: sibling version pin for the metadata document; bump on an incompatible shape change

aiGenerations.rule: the caller passes space_id/kind/view/chunk_index through the gateway call like run_id/run_stage; the gateway never writes these tags itself

inventory_rows: retrieval_query_rollups.latency_histogram :: keep-open bounded latency histogram (le buckets + overflow; TTL 30d)
queryRollups.written_by: plan 50 P2 telemetry hooks (batched off the request hot path)

coverageSnapshots.written_by: reconcile pass + periodic maintenance ANN-recall probe (never a dashboard request)

backgroundJobs.reaper_action: running row with heartbeat_at older than the stale window -> failed (error='stalled: no heartbeat for 15m'), emit vector.run.stalled, release lock_key

inventory: ai_generations.metadata :: keep-open caller-supplied embedding tags (space_id/kind/view/chunk_index; schema version sibling; never text)
retrieval_query_rollups :: operational (TTL 30d — aggregate, not an audit ledger)
retrieval_coverage_snapshots :: operational (TTL 90d — latest snapshot wins; cold means never reconciled)
background_jobs.idempotency_key :: indexed request replay key (partial unique on job_type+idempotency_key; 24h TTL)
background_jobs.lock_key :: partial unique active-run lock (vector_space:<space_id>; queued/running only)
background_jobs.progress_detail :: bounded live counters (documents/chunks/tokens; no ids or text; pruned when the final result commits)

dtoSafety.rule: Retrieval DTOs and exports never carry prompt/document/query/output text; golden-query text is admin fixture input and never crosses a Quality DTO.
